scripts.db: npm run db:setup && npm run db:init
scripts.dev: concurrently -k --color --prefix "[ {name} ] >" --prefix-colors "blue,green" -n SERVER," VITE " "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.preview: npm run build:frontend && concurrently -k --color --prefix "[ {name} ] >" --prefix-colors "blue,green" -n SERVER,PREVIEW "npm run dev:backend" "npm run preview:frontend"
